name: tuckit
description: Use tuckit as your project's single source of truth: domain knowledge, board-freshness hooks, and a design->steps->execute->review->ship workflow that writes every artifact to the board instead of to docs/. A replacement for Superpowers' planning skills, not a companion to them.

mcp_url.title: tuckit MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Your workspace's MCP endpoint. Leave the default for tuckit Cloud; set your own only if self-hosting. Authorization happens in your browser on first use — no token to paste.
